verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides GitHub Actions-compatible CI/CD that runs inside your own self-hosted Gitea instances. Community users also report running self-hosted CI with Gitea plus Drone, and the docs list Drone, Woodpecker and Jenkins integrations. The evidence never explicitly describes registering or managing self-hosted or private runners, so running jobs on your own runners is only implied by the self-hosted deployment model. missing for 10: explicit documentation of self-hosted/private runner registration and management, runner labels or scoping, and hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions jobs running on private runners.
